from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def create_battery(self, color="#C0C0C0"):
        body = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.05, height=0.5, width=0.3, color=color, fill_opacity=0.3)
        tip = Rectangle(height=0.08, width=0.15, color=color, fill_opacity=1).next_to(body, UP, buff=0)
        return VGroup(body, tip)

    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Real-World Application", [
            "The CLT is the foundation of modern statistics.",
            "We can predict populations from just a few samples.",
            "Science and industry rely on this mathematical magic."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display silver (#C0C0C0) battery icons to represent a large factory production.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        batteries = VGroup()
        for r in ["B", "C", "D"]:
            for c in ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]:
                bat = self.create_battery("#C0C0C0")
                self.place_at_grid(bat, f"{r}{c}", scale_factor=0.8)
                batteries.add(bat)
        
        pop_label = Text("Population N = 1,000,000", font_size=20, color="#C0C0C0")
        self.place_at_grid(pop_label, "A3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(batteries), Write(pop_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Contrast the total population N with a small sample group n=30 in yellow (#FFFF00).
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY), 
            self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        
        # Highlight a specific block of batteries as the sample
        sample_indices = [7, 8, 9, 13, 14, 15] 
        sample_group = VGroup(*[batteries[i] for i in sample_indices])
        
        sample_label = Text("n = 30 (Sample)", font_size=20, color="#FFFF00")
        self.place_at_grid(sample_label, "E2", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(
            sample_group.animate.set_color("#FFFF00").set_fill("#FFFF00", opacity=0.8),
            Write(sample_label)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Draw a green (#00FF00) bell curve to represent the predictable quality confidence.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY), 
            self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)
        )
        
        # Bell curve representation
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-3, 3],
            y_range=[0, 1.2],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "include_ticks": False},
            x_length=4,
            y_length=1.5
        ).set_color(GREEN)
        
        def normal_dist(x):
            return np.exp(-x**2)
            
        bell_curve = axes.plot(normal_dist, color="#00FF00")
        curve_group = VGroup(axes, bell_curve)
        
        # Positioning curve in the lower right area
        self.place_in_area(curve_group, "E4", "F6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        confidence_label = Text("Confidence in Quality", font_size=20, color="#00FF00")
        self.place_at_grid(confidence_label, "D6", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(
            Create(bell_curve), 
            FadeIn(axes), 
            Write(confidence_label)
        )
        self.wait(3)
